abstract.t:
In AI training scenarios, per-flow ECMP is the mainstream load balancing technology deployed in current networks. However, inherent hash collision issues of traditional ECMP lead to imbalanced traffic distribution, adversely affecting application performance.
To address this problem, this document proposes an enhanced ECMP method that resolves load imbalance caused by hash collisions. The proposed solution effectively improves load balancing efficiency, reduces network congestion, and enhances overall network performance.
